neighbours.label: Perfect or passive predicate inside a that/whether/relative clause ('confirm that your payment has been received', 'the films that you have downloaded'); main-clause perfects stay quiet
fire: Please check that your order has been shipped before you call us.
You can only read the books that you have purchased on this device.
The letter states that the fee has been paid in advance.
If a customer feels that her privacy was violated, she may file a complaint.
Residents can see whether the repairs they requested have been completed.
Make sure that your ticket has been stamped before you board.
The app shows the songs that you have saved for offline listening.
The hotel must confirm that the room has been booked in your name.
quiet: I have shipped three orders to customers this morning.
She has purchased two books for the long flight.
The fee has been paid in advance by the tenant.
A customer filed a complaint about her privacy on Tuesday.
The repairs have been completed ahead of schedule.
The conductor has stamped every ticket on the train.
We have saved many songs for offline listening.
The room has been booked for the whole week.

notes: Card: Spanish/Russian/English auxiliaries and participles in subordinate clauses (que has descargado, han sido implementadas, что проживание оплачено). Probes: 0.27-0.33 on English that-clause perfects, 0.01-0.02 on main-clause 'I have downloaded' / 'The rules have been followed'. Weak pole: fire level is near the 0.20 bar.
